title: Two cosmic viewpoints
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Each observer has a region from which signals could have reached them. Different locations have different observable regions, although those regions can overlap.

misconception: A learner may choose: Yes: every observer sees exactly the same region
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Would observers in very distant galaxies necessarily have exactly the same observable region as Earth?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Would observers in very distant galaxies necessarily have exactly the same observable region as Earth? No: their observable regions are centered on their locations. Each observer has a region from which signals could have reached them. Different locations have different observable regions, although those regions can overlap.
Visual caption: Different viewpoint, horizon. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
